new.title: Directors and viewers see Cancel invoice, Mark printed, Edit, Verify and Delete payment buttons that the server refuses
new.body: At steps 25 and 26 the Invoices and Payments pages check only the sidebar permission expense:read. Every row action is then shown to anyone who can open the page. The server guards each action with its own leaf: expense.invoice.cancel, expense.invoice.update, expense.payment.update, expense.writeOff.verify and expense.payment.delete. The seeded director and viewer roles hold only the read leaves (expense.invoice.read, expense.payment.read). A director signing off money, or a viewer, therefore sees live Cancel invoice, Mark printed, Edit, Verify and Delete buttons on every row. Pressing one opens a confirm or edit dialog, and the request comes back FORBIDDEN. The SOP gives these actions to Accounting and the Cashier only.
new.note: found by zyt-audit (role-mismatch)

new.title: A foreign-currency receipt saved without an exchange rate is counted 1:1 in the Payments footer totals
new.body: At step 26, when the currency differs from the reporting currency, the payment form tells the cashier they may leave the exchange rate blank ('Leave blank if the bank's rate is not known'). The server then stores the literal 1. Settlement treats a stored 1 as 'no rate captured', but the Payments list footer does not. paymentTotals multiplies every amount by the stored rate with a fallback of 1, and the endpoint comment says the figures are converted to the org base currency. A USD 10,000 receipt with no rate therefore adds 10,000 to Receipts, Collected, Balance and Receivable in base currency, with no marker that the figure is unconverted. Accounting reads a cash position that looks complete and is wrong by the exchange rate. This is a different screen and code path from the open profit-statement item, which covers bills, not payments.
